instruction: Open the Sharpen (Unsharp Mask) filter dialog for me.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to open the Sharpen (Unsharp Mask) filter dialog in GIMP. The evaluator checks GIMP's action-history file for the 'filters-unsharp-mask' action, which is recorded when the dialog is opened. This is similar in complexity to the original Vignette task - just navigating through GIMP's Filters menu to open a different filter dialog.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks GIMP's action-history file for the 'filters-unsharp-mask' action, which is the proper way to verify that the Sharpen (Unsharp Mask) filter dialog was opened
The getter (get_vm_command_line) correctly reads the action-history file after GIMP closes via postconfig
The metric (check_include_exclude) correctly verifies that 'filters-unsharp-mask' is present in the action history and excludes error messages
Postconfig properly closes the filter dialog and quits GIMP to ensure the action-history file is written to disk before verification
Complete instruction coverage: the single requirement (opening the dialog) is fully verified by checking for the corresponding action in the history file
Data flow is semantically correct: action history file content -> include/exclude pattern matching -> verification of the specific filter action
